theme_strategy.description: Edtech UI demands high clarity for extended study sessions, combined with playful elements. Light mode acts as a clean 'Notion-like' workspace, while dark mode provides a low-eye-strain 'focus' environment for coding and reading.

typography.instructions: Import Google Fonts: Outfit (wght: 400;600;800;900), Figtree (wght: 400;500;600), JetBrains Mono (wght: 400;700).

layout_and_grids.sidebar: fixed inset-y-0 left-0 w-[240px] border-r border-border bg-surface p-6 z-40 hidden md:flex flex-col gap-8
layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 inside cards to allow content to breathe. Gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections.

component_guidelines.cards: Flat design with slight roundness (rounded-2xl). border-2 border-border/60. Subtle tactile feel via shadow-[0_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] in light mode.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions, rounded-xl for secondary. Must have scale transition on active/click. Example: hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 active:shadow-none.
component_guidelines.chat_drawer: Fixed right panel or slide-over drawer (w-80 or w-96). Use Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60. Must have 1px inner stroke.
component_guidelines.mastery_bars: Thick rounded progress bars (h-3 rounded-full). Use animated width filling.
component_guidelines.forms: Use highly customized Shadcn inputs with strong focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500 focus:ring-offset-2).

gamification.streaks: Show fire icon with lime/amber text. Use bounce animations on increase.
gamification.xp: Circular progress rings or bold counters with counter-up animation.
gamification.badges: Display as 3D-looking icons or highly saturated SVG geometric shapes within rounded-xl containers.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle SVG noise overlays across the background for the Notion 'paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for crisp structural navigation. Use 'phosphor-react' (duotone) for playful subject categories.
visual_enhancers.motion: Staggered fade-up (framer-motion) for dashboard bento grid items. Micro-interactions on all hoverable elements.

libraries.charts: recharts - REQUIRED for Radar Chart (skills) and Heatmap/Bar chart (progress).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Provide focus rings on all interactable elements. No hover-only interactions for core functionality.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. E.g., data-testid='start-quiz-button', data-testid='xp-counter'.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for Headings. Use Outfit.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Emphasize left-aligned reading structures for lessons.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under overlays (Chat drawer MUST have solid or blurred background).
Avoid AI emojis (🤖🧠💡). Use Lucide or Phosphor icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use layered design elements with clear z-index hierarchy.
instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React code as standard JavaScript.
Install recharts, framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react and sonner via yarn before starting.
Build the dashboard using a Bento-grid layout model. Create dedicated sections for Progress, AI Tutor Drawer, and Learning Path Cards.
Ensure the UI reflects 'Duolingo meets Notion' - structural blocks but with fun, vibrant pill buttons and gamified progress elements.
Always apply data-testid attributes to buttons, links, inputs, and major containers.
